definition: [||Sx-u||^2 + lambda ||x||^2] / same objective of independently validated standard output; x real nonnegative, lambda=0.001 ||S||F. S is independent-background corrected calibration, u is 1000-cycle foreground mean minus background mean.
tolerance_provenance: One-sided attained convex objective bound; 1e-10 relative slack covers floating-point accumulation and is fixed before candidate testing. Reference coordinates are not an accuracy target.
